summary: Next.js 12 → 14 (13.0.0–14.2.35): 206 risk paths (98 high, 94 medium, 14 low). Main categories: changed behavior (56), configuration change (56), removed api (43), runtime requirement (22). Most severe: Absolute image imports from /public must be converted to relative imports (high); App directory API Routes require migration to Route Handlers (high); App directory code reads removed router locales (high). Verified: 60 high-, 100 medium- and 46 low-confidence or disputed risks; 66 source disagreements. 65 open questions. Overall confidence: medium.
